pages.text: A second strike on a carved cell cuts it $(bold)deeper$(). Deep cells are how $(l:socket-sorcery:modifiers/overview)modifiers$(/l) are written: certain exact sets of deep cells strengthen the engraving.$(br2)Close one and its cells alone flare as the table names it. A wrong set holds nothing — the gem waits, unfinished, until you make it right or smooth it away.
